question: Should OpenClaw core bundle this Vault exec SecretRef resolver and accept its Gateway credential, network, dependency-graph, and plugin-activation trust boundary after the docs fix?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and uses the existing SecretRef plugin-integration seam, but bundling a Vault resolver changes the core distribution’s security and operator-support boundary in a way automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve after docs and secops review
options.body: Fix the multi-tenant guidance, then have maintainers/security approve the bundled resolver, dependency graph delta, and plugin activation behavior for the final head.

options.title: Keep Vault external
options.body: Pause or close this PR as core scope and ask for a ClawHub or external plugin package using the existing `secretProviderIntegrations` seam.

options.title: Narrow to manual exec docs
options.body: Do not bundle a resolver yet; document a manual Vault exec provider pattern until the permanent Vault ownership model is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve after docs and secops review
recommendation.body: Fix the multi-tenant guidance, then have maintainers/security approve the bundled resolver, dependency graph delta, and plugin activation behavior for the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent secrets docs/source ownership signals make this the best available individual routing target, while final security approval still belongs to the secops-reviewed path.
